## Squachy has outfits now. Also the rotate button doesn't lie to you anymore.

Two unrelated things happened this release and both were overdue. First: the rotate button used to occasionally freeze up or go glitchy for a beat, because every single rotation was throwing away the whole frame buffer and begging the heap for a new one — like re-renting the same apartment every time you turned around in it. Turns out landscape and portrait need the exact same amount of memory (a rectangle has the same number of pixels no matter which way you hold it, shockingly), so now it just grabs the memory once at boot and reuses it forever. No more gambling against heap fragmentation eleven times a day.

Second, and much more important: Squachy can now wear costumes. Ten of them. Two are free (a raccoon — sorry, "Tanooki Squach" — and a pastel unicorn with an actual candy-cane rainbow horn), the rest unlock as you catch more things, same milestone stat his growth stages already use. There's also a hidden button combo that unlocks everything at once, because of course there is. I'm not telling you what it is. Figure it out or read the code, I don't care, I built it either way.

### The actually-useful part
- **Fixed**: rotate button no longer risks a stutter/freeze from heap fragmentation — the frame buffer is allocated once at boot and reused for every orientation instead of being freed and reallocated on every tap
- **Added**: 10 unlockable Squachy outfits (Tanooki Squach, Unicorn, Tinfoil Squach, Shadow Squach, Plumber Bro, Tall Bro, Space Squach, Blue Blur, Captain Squach — plus a hidden unlock-everything gesture)
- **Added**: a dedicated OUTFIT screen in Settings with a live preview and left/right arrows, instead of blind-cycling and checking the main screen
- New rotate icon (an actual circular arrow, not the old abstract flip glyph) and black title-bar text
- ALERT screen's target-type text and the LOG screen's per-detection type label both use the same comic-impact font as "!! DETECTION !!" now, instead of the plain library default
- Squachy's patrol walk now does 5 full side-to-side laps instead of 1
- 12 new lines for when you pet him, and every speech bubble now stays up at least 5 seconds instead of 4
- Removed the Radar Sweep, Rain on Glass, and Aurora backgrounds; Terminal Log now flashes a dramatic banner line ("ACCESS GRANTED," "INTRUSION DETECTED," etc.) every so often instead of just scrolling forever with no personality
- Fixed a couple of stray "Sasquatch" spellings that didn't match the project's own documented "Sasquach" style rule (yes, I have a style rule for my own name, don't ask)
